input.topic: Laravel-Lang supply-chain attack rewrites historical Composer package tags to deliver credential-stealing malware, May 2026

candidate_data.sector: Software supply chain / open-source package ecosystem / PHP Composer

input.notes: Manual intake from Risky Bulletin dated 2026-05-25. Risky summarized this as a supply-chain attack against Laravel developers in which Laravel-Lang package tags were rewritten and credential-stealing code was loaded through Composer autoload behavior. Use Aikido, StepSecurity, and Snyk as the source base. Keep the article scoped to the May 22-23, 2026 Laravel-Lang compromise involving historical tag rewrites/republication, affected laravel-lang packages, flipboxstudio[.]info infrastructure, and credential/CI-secret theft risk. Avoid overstating attribution; current public sources describe an unknown actor or single actor using compromised org access. Note that contemporaneous zero-day items from the same bulletin for Trend Micro Apex One CVE-2026-34926, Drupal CVE-2026-9082, and LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin CVE-2026-48172 already exist in origin/main task state and should not be duplicated.
